decision: 5 second time penalty. 2 penalty points (total of 4 for the 12 month period).
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 d) of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video, in-car video evidence. BOT was about to overtake SAR at turn 11 on the outside. The Stewards determined that SAR was predominantely to blame for the collision. Applying the 2023 Driving Standard Guidelines for overtaking on the outside of a corner, the Stewards noted that BOT left plenty of room for SAR, while he came alongside. SAR braked late, locked his tyres and thereby caused the collision..
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 2 Causing A Collision
